name: new-up-hop
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0
ahdl_include "dut.va"
Vcmd (cmd 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0.8 1.3e-05 0.8 1.3000001e-05 1.03 0.0002 1.03]
DUT (cmd out tune) identified_pll
simulatorOptions options reltol=1e-7 vabstol=1e-10 iabstol=1e-13
tran tran stop=0.0002 maxstep=1e-8 errpreset=conservative
save out tune cmd
